summary_en: This Phase 2 study compares therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE) followed by enfortumab vedotin and pembrolizumab with standard next-line therapy. It is for people with bladder or upper urinary tract urothelial cancer that has spread and has not responded to previous treatment. TPE is given on days 1 to 3 of cycles 1 to 3, enfortumab vedotin and pembrolizumab are given by vein, and cycles repeat every 21 days in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. The main outcome is not stated in the record; this is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 compara el intercambio terapéutico de plasma (TPE) seguido de enfortumab vedotina y pembrolizumab con la terapia estándar de siguiente línea. Está dirigido a personas con cáncer urotelial de vejiga o de vías urinarias superiores que se ha diseminado y no ha respondido a tratamientos previos. El TPE se administra los días 1 a 3 de los ciclos 1 a 3, la enfortumab vedotina y el pembrolizumab se dan por vena, y los ciclos se repiten cada 21 días mientras no haya progresión de la enfermedad ni toxicidad inaceptable. El resultado principal no está indicado en el registro; este es un estudio de fase 2.
who_for: Urothelial carcinoma of the bladder or upper urinary tract that progressed despite enfortumab vedotin and pembrolizumab (Groups A and B).
Urothelial carcinoma that progressed despite an antibody-drug conjugate and is not a candidate for Groups A and B (Cohort C).
Measurable disease and ECOG performance status 0, 1, or 2.
Blood counts, liver and kidney tests within set limits, obtained within 30 days before registration.
not_for: Pregnant or nursing, or able to become pregnant or father a child and unwilling to use contraception.
Any neuroendocrine or signet ring cell features in the tumor.
Another active cancer that is progressing or needing treatment change within 24 months, with listed exceptions.
Uncontrolled heart disease or certain heart or brain events within 6 months.
Psychiatric illness or substance use that would limit study compliance, or investigator judges participation not in the participant's best interest.
cancer_types: renal pelvis and ureter urothelial carcinoma
